baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Umbra (shadow) in latin – is a horror / twilight zone themed map. Basically it is complete darkness and your only source of light are the various lamp post in the map. Watch out as zombies come through the shadows in every direction – remember to stay in the light! This map was made purely for fun and was made in a day – I thought this would be an original take on a standard box map but in a larger and scarier scale – hope you enjoy your visit to the twilight zone! Features Re skinned PaP, Mystery box and starter pistol (Little Devil) 4 standard perks quizz’s instant grenades Instant runners complete darkness buyable ending Bo2 Shaders No DOGS! 5 Box Locations -Massive Darkness with few light zones

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
